name: Immigration counsel (category guide)
summary: Category entry for EP refusals/appeals, age-banded qualifying salary vs COMPASS C1, Tech.Pass, ONE Pass, LTVP common-law, visit-pass extensions, Work Holiday / Training EP, lost-card edge cases, FCF timing, ACRA/officer LOC questions, Tuition Grant / NS edge cases, retrenchment STVP asks, training-bond exit timing, and side-income questions — use regulated advisers when HR scripts run out.
body: Most straightforward EP issues are employer-led via MOM. Engage immigration counsel for refusals and 3-month employer-only appeals, IPA/medical issuance clocks that collide with STVP expiry, offers that miss the published age-banded EP floor (non-FS from S$5,600 / FS from S$6,200 at the youngest band in current tables, with 2027/2028 steps already published), or confusion between Stage 1 qualifying salary and COMPASS C1 percentiles. Complex dependants, common-law LTVP evidence packs, EntrePass / Tech.Pass / ONE Pass conversions, PEP one-shot timing, or PR strategy — not for routine first-pass filing your HR already owns. ACRA incorporation via a CSP is not a work pass; EP secondary directorship and DP business LOCs are MOM products with related-company and local-hire traps. Short internship and working-holiday paths (Work Holiday Programme, AU/NZ Work & Holiday, Training Employment Pass) are easy to confuse with tourist visit passes — counsel helps when schools sit off MOM’s sample lists or employers invent illegal ‘start first, pass later’ plans. Fair Consideration Framework advertising (≥14 days on MyCareersFuture unless exempt) sits before many EP submissions; counsel helps when ICT exemptions, salary-band mismatches, or debarment risk enter the chat. Short-Term Visit Pass confusion is common: ICA online extensions while waiting for a first pass are not the same as MOM’s post-cancellation STVP — overstaying or JB visa runs are how clean files become messy. After retrenchment, ask HR in writing for the longest STVP on cancel and parallel a contractual benefit / TADM path; counsel helps when DP/LTVP cascade or graduate LTVP timing is non-standard. Job changes need a new employer IPA before resignation — training bonds and clawbacks are contract fights that should not be confused with MOM cancellation clocks. Lost or stolen pass cards are usually an HR EP eService replacement within one week; counsel helps when repeated losses trigger interviews or when you are stuck overseas without a re-entry letter. Side-income questions (content creation, overseas remote on DP) start from MOM FAQs; counsel helps when your employer’s risk team will not accept a link alone. Male ex-PRs who renounced before NS should get written CMPB clarity before assuming an EP transfer will clear — COMPASS is not a NS waiver. International graduates on MOE Tuition Grant bonds need counsel when liquidated-damages clocks collide with pass cancellation. Foreign spouses leaving abusive sponsors need immigration advice *after* safety (NAVH / PPO) — pass dependency myths should not delay police or Protection Specialist Centres. Death of a main pass holder is an ICA + estate problem, not a Facebook pass conversion.
